column1: # Eclipse's games view and its empty state, element by element (EmuSen_Qt.md §3.4.7.2); read by tests/eclipse_games.rs.
# board: the design project's file and line (EclipseLibrary = "Eclipse theme, a console's games", EclipseEmpty = "first run with no games"), each 1920 x 1200.
# status: built (drawn by Frontend/themes/eclipse/screens/Games.qml and held by the test); home (the part Home's board draws too, Home's to build);
#   not-drawn (the program has nothing for it: the reason in "program"); open (waits on a ruling, named in "program").
# checks: board pixels, converted by the test as value x canvas::DESIGN_HEIGHT / board_h. x, y, w, h: the item's box; right: the canvas's width less the
#   box's right edge; cy: the box's vertical centre; below=item:gap: the top is that item's bottom plus gap; after=item:gap: the left is that
#   item's right plus gap; font: the type's pixel size; ink: the words' colour;
#   fill: the item's colour. A row with no checks is not drawn.
